statement_summary: Program covers business IT and OT; documented in policies, standards, and the SSP
Information Security Lead and OT security lead designated in writing; IT and OT RACI
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30 and SP 800-82 OT threat guidance
Risk acceptance authority by level; no safety or release risk accepted above Low
Safety first: no security measure may bypass safety shutdowns; OT change impact review
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Sanctions
Supplier security schedule before OT access or Restricted data; no OT vendor connection without review
Written, time-limited exceptions; VP Operations agrees to OT exceptions
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 suppliers
Annual independent control assessment
Quarterly legal and regulatory watch with applicability triggers
regulatory_driver: N21-BM (SP 800-82r3 5.3.4); N21-R02 (TSA notice watch); N21-R03 (proposed; tracked)

statement_summary: Six-year retention of security records; Part 195 records for their required period
AI approved through the P10 process; no AI write path to SCADA
Unique accounts; shared HMI engineering account replaced by 2027-03-31 with compensating controls
Role-based least privilege with manager and data owner approval
MFA for all; phishing-resistant MFA for IT, cloud, and OT administrators
Termination: same-day IdP disable; SCADA local accounts and gate combinations within 1 business day
Remove prior-role access within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews including SCADA, controller, and shipper portal accounts
Separate privileged accounts; PAM for cloud and directory now and OT administration by 2027-06-30
Lockout and screen lock; OCC HMIs exempt under the OT overlay
Break-glass accounts for the IdP, cloud, and SCADA servers, tested quarterly
Password rules; default and vendor-shared passwords prohibited on field devices
Vendor remote access only through the jump host; always-on vendor paths removed by 2026-11-30
IT/OT boundary through an OT DMZ at every control site; no internet-reachable field management
Badge access to control centers; quarterly gate combination changes; locked cabinets
IR plan with OT annex and two runbooks
Report within 1 hour; Production Controllers report unexplained HMI behavior
Log incidents and record discovery time
Authority to isolate the IT/OT connections; MDR limited to IT hosts
Crisis management team within 2 hours for severity 1
Cyber events affecting the gathering system trigger the pipeline emergency procedures and the 1-hour NRC decision
Breach determination and decision log by General Counsel; Florida no-notice determination kept 5 years
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix; oil discharge notice immediately
Insurer hotline before engaging vendors
Ransom decision with OFAC check; no decryptors on SCADA
Annual exercises per runbook, per area, and for the CMT; one joint with a pipeline drill
Lessons learned within 30 days
Four-level classification including OT configuration and trade secret data
Encrypt Restricted data; approved secure transfer only; documented OT exceptions
Data minimization: Social Security numbers only in source systems; de-identified analytics extracts
Restricted data inventory reconciled quarterly; OT inventory complete by 2027-06-30
Certified sanitization including retired OT devices; voluntary application of the Florida disposal standard
Immutable cloud backups; SCADA images offline in 2 locations; quarterly restore tests
Company-managed keys; separate backup keys
Each shipper sees only its own data
No Restricted or Confidential data in unapproved AI tools
Retention schedule including Part 195 records
Business use only; no personal use of SCADA equipment
Acknowledgment at hire and annually
Annual training for all; field briefings complete by 2026-12-31; annual OT refresher; payment fraud training
No USB or personal devices on OT; scanning kiosk; vendor laptops checked
No unapproved software
Company-managed devices only; report lost devices
Call-back verification of payment changes
Approved AI tools only; human review; no AI changes to SCADA; no AI employee ranking without HR review
Monitoring notice including telematics; telematics used for safety, dispatch, and hours of service
